project.name: TianShu Operations Platform
project.objective: Help firmware administrators distinguish lifecycle, signature, and rollout risk before taking a controlled action.
project.audience: Firmware administrators, engineering administrators, and production operations

directions.name: Release Ledger
directions.hypothesis: A dense version ledger lets operators distinguish lifecycle, signature, and conditional next actions within the first viewport.

directions.name: Canary Command
directions.hypothesis: Elevating canary progress and rollback risk shortens assessment and intervention time for active rollouts.

directions.name: Fleet Continuity
directions.hypothesis: Leading with bound devices and model coverage helps operations assess blast radius before choosing a version action.

miniDesignBrief.colorIntent: Ops Canvas neutral layered surfaces with one blue primary action and semantic success, warning, and danger states paired with text
miniDesignBrief.typeIntent: Compact Inter or Segoe UI system typography with tabular version, device-count, percentage, and timestamp values
